goal.ask: What do you want to do in InspectAI Studio?
goal.why: Setup, model building and settings live in different modules; building a model then depends on the project type.

options.label: Install the software or activate the licence
Build, train or deploy an inspection model
Look up a setting (epochs, learning rate, GPU)

task.why: The three project types have different steps: only classification needs labelled classes, anomaly detection trains on good parts only, text reading needs annotated lines.

options.label: Sort parts into classes (e.g. OK, Scratch, Dent)
Find defects, learning from good parts only
Read printed or engraved text (batch codes, serial numbers)
Not sure which project type I need

source.ask: Where will the training images come from?
source.why: Import has two options (2.2 / 3.2): a folder on disk or the line camera, with different steps.

options.label: Not decided yet / images already imported

annotation.ask: How will you annotate the text?
annotation.why: Section 4.2 has two methods: manual suits unusual fonts, assisted is about three times faster for standard fonts.

options.label: Assisted: the built-in reader proposes, I correct (standard font)
